units.title: SG-6.1 · Add a listExecutions admin client function
Act: Add listExecutions to the admin client
Act: Add the current-Round ExecutionInfo lookup
Verify: listExecutions unit tests with mocked fetch

tests.id: executions.test.ts > listExecutions > sends GET with Bearer token and returns the array
tests.name: listExecutions sends GET with Bearer token and returns the array
tests.title: listExecutions sends GET with Bearer token and returns the array
tests.scenario: Given fetch is stubbed to return 200 with [executionFixture], When listExecutions('tok') is called, Then the result equals [executionFixture], fetch is called once with '/api/v1/admin/executions', and the Authorization header is 'Bearer tok'

tests.name: listExecutions rejects with ApiError 401
tests.title: listExecutions rejects with ApiError 401
tests.scenario: Given fetch is stubbed to return 401, When listExecutions('bad') is called, Then the promise rejects with an ApiError whose status is 401

units.title: Verify: Current-Round lookup unit tests with mocked fetch

tests.id: findExecutionForRound::returns the execution whose round_id matches
tests.name: findExecutionForRound returns the execution whose round_id matches
tests.title: findExecutionForRound returns the execution whose round_id matches
tests.scenario: Given two executions for round-1 and round-2, When looking up round-1, Then the round-1 execution (id 'a') is returned
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executions.test.ts --testTimeout=10000 -t findExecutionForRound

tests.id: findExecutionForRound::returns undefined when no execution matches the round
tests.name: findExecutionForRound returns undefined when no execution matches the round
tests.title: findExecutionForRound returns undefined when no execution matches the round
tests.scenario: Given executions for round-1 and round-2, When looking up round-9, Then undefined is returned
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executions.test.ts --testTimeout=10000 -t findExecutionForRound

tests.id: findExecutionForRound::returns the newest execution by updated_at when several match
tests.name: findExecutionForRound returns the newest execution by updated_at when several match
tests.title: findExecutionForRound returns the newest execution by updated_at when several match
tests.scenario: Given two round-1 executions updated at 00:00:10Z and 00:00:50Z, When looking up round-1, Then the later one ('newer') is returned
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executions.test.ts --testTimeout=10000 -t findExecutionForRound

tests.id: getCurrentRoundExecution::resolves to the execution of the current round and calls both endpoints
tests.name: getCurrentRoundExecution resolves to the execution of the current round and calls both endpoints
tests.title: getCurrentRoundExecution resolves to the execution of the current round and calls both endpoints
tests.scenario: Given the current round is round-1 and the list holds a round-2 execution and an exec-1 round-1 execution, When getCurrentRoundExecution('tok') runs with mocked fetch, Then it resolves to exec-1 and fetch was called with the round/current and admin/executions URLs
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executions.test.ts --testTimeout=10000 -t getCurrentRoundExecution

tests.id: getCurrentRoundExecution::resolves to undefined when the list only has executions for other rounds
tests.name: getCurrentRoundExecution resolves to undefined when the list only has executions for other rounds
tests.title: getCurrentRoundExecution resolves to undefined when the list only has executions for other rounds
tests.scenario: Given the current round is round-1 and the list only holds a round-2 execution, When getCurrentRoundExecution('tok') runs with mocked fetch, Then it resolves to undefined
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/executions.test.ts --testTimeout=10000 -t getCurrentRoundExecution
